title: The Fulfilment Map After Nine Days of Strikes
subtitle: Four Wildberries sites are reported destroyed, two burned or damaged with the extent unclear, and one survivor sits at the centre of the company's public claims.

source.name: Site-level damage assessments compiled from Russian regional reporting and geolocated video

data.label: Udmurtia
data.detail: Reported destroyed, removing the site from the fulfilment network entirely.

data.label: Penza
data.detail: Reported destroyed alongside the Udmurtia facility.

data.label: Volgograd
data.detail: Reported destroyed in a region that also lost refinery capacity in the same period.

data.label: Samara
data.detail: Reported destroyed, cutting a major Volga distribution point.

data.label: Ryazan
data.detail: The site burned; whether half or all of the building was lost is still unconfirmed.

data.label: Perm
data.detail: Possibly damaged and in any case still not operational.

data.label: Tambov
data.detail: Interior video suggests roughly half the building is damaged, but the site continues to operate.

data.label: Yekaterinburg
data.detail: The company claimed the site repelled 200 drones; the available video shows a single impact on the car park.

metadata.keyFinding: Four sites are reported destroyed while the company publicised a site that took a single parking-lot hit.
